mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within three months signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5% within three months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP by more than 2% over a quarter signals strong economic demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings and consumer confidence rise.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the quarters when GDPC1 increases by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 1% within a month signals a weakening supply side, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it indicates a potential economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when INDPRO decreases by more than 1% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 over a month signals a strong labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as it boosts consumer confidence and spending.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures signals a strengthening demand side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and housing market activity rise.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when both HOUST and RSAFS increase.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index by more than 0.5% within a month signals rising inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate tighter monetary policy.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decrease in the unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls signals a robust labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when UNRATE decreases and PAYEMS increases.
